task_completion.description: Open the web browser and the Network tab of Developer Tools to begin recording.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A browser window is open with the 'Network' tab visible in the Developer Tools pane.

task_completion.description: Navigate to and submit the form at https://httpbin.org/forms/post.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The browser shows the httpbin.org/forms/post page, and the Network tab logs a POST request to this URL.

task_completion.description: Navigate to https://httpbin.org/delay/3 to capture a slow response.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The browser address bar shows 'httpbin.org/delay/3' and the Network tab shows a request with a significant time duration (approx 3 seconds).

task_completion.description: Navigate to https://httpbin.org/status/503 to capture a server error.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The Network tab shows a request to 'httpbin.org/status/503' with a status code of 503 (Service Unavailable) highlighted in red.

task_completion.description: Export the captured network activity as a HAR file from the Developer Tools.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The user clicks the 'Export HAR' (down arrow icon) or right-clicks in the Network tab to select 'Save all as HAR with content'.

task_completion.description: Save the exported file as 'incident_trace.har' to /home/ga/Desktop.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A file save dialog or a file manager view shows 'incident_trace.har' located on the Desktop.

integrity.description: The agent must use the browser's GUI and Developer Tools rather than generating a file via script/curl.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the mouse cursor interacting with the browser's Network tab and the export menu.

integrity.description: The HAR file must contain actual traffic from the specified URLs, not a dummy file.
integrity.visual_evidence: The Network tab shows real-time population of requests for 'forms/post', 'delay/3', and 'status/503' with corresponding status codes.

integrity.description: The agent should not use a text editor to manually create the HAR content.
integrity.visual_evidence: The agent is seen using the browser's built-in export functionality rather than a text editor like Gedit or VS Code.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The task requires capturing three specific events in one HAR file: a POST request to https://httpbin.org/forms/post, a 3-second delayed response from https://httpbin.org/delay/3, and a 503 error from https://httpbin.org/status/503. The final file must be named 'incident_trace.har' and placed in '/home/ga/Desktop'. Verify that the Network tab is recording throughout all three navigations to ensure a 'combined' trace.
